title: Parker Solar Probe Hit 430,000 MPH Without Carrying A Human
hook: Parker Solar Probe reached 430,000 miles an hour; no human rode along.
closing: The fastest machine is uncrewed; its record is a measure of engineering, not a speed people have experienced.
question: What would you explore with this speed?

segments.say: Parker Solar Probe reached 430,000 miles an hour in the latest supplied record. Its speed kept rising across the measurements.
Parker travels roughly 17 times the fastest human speed in this comparison. A machine can endure a mission people have not ridden.
At Parker's record speed, New York to Tokyo would take 56 seconds. This is a scale comparison, not an actual flight.
